summary: Iter 20 — social media footer + admin editor. Backend pytest 11/11 PASS (public GET, admin PUT auto-prefix, clear, tagline-only, 401/403 gating, unknown-platform drop, public empty-filter, regression). Frontend E2E 12 steps PASS with 0 JS console errors: login → /admin → Social Links tab → 14 platform rows render → blur-save Instagram (toast + green ✓) → Open button has correct https-prefixed href → tagline blur-save toast → live preview icon appears → footer renders on /, /signin, /marketplace, /about, /contact, /terms, /privacy with brand, About/Contact/Terms/Privacy links, © year copyright, social icons (target=_blank, rel=noopener) → Clear button empties input, removes preview icon, footer reverts to 'Social links coming soon' message → Analytics reset btn still visible (regression OK).

minor.issue: BEFORE FIX: response was `_get_doc(db) | {ok:True}` which is missing `platforms_supported`. Frontend SocialLinksAdmin uses `doc.platforms_supported` to render the 14 rows, so after any save the rows VANISHED. Fixed in site_settings.py — PUT now returns the same shape as GET admin (links, tagline, platforms_supported, updated_at, ok).

action_items: Validate the backend PUT-response fix landed in /app/backend/site_settings.py (now returns platforms_supported). 11/11 pytest + full E2E green after the fix.

(Cosmetic, low-priority) Tagline-only PUT body validates fine, but the body model allows arbitrary `links` keys then silently drops them — consider returning a 4xx with a list of dropped keys to surface admin typos. Currently they vanish silently.
critical_code_review_comments: site_settings.py — DEFAULT_PLATFORMS is a tuple; tests confirm all 14 are exposed and unknown keys are silently dropped (good).
site_settings.py:_validate_url — auto-prefixes https:// when scheme is missing; verified `instagram.com/lumo` → `https://instagram.com/lumo`. Also enforces 500-char max.
_get_doc seeds the doc on first read (insert_one) — idempotent because it queries by _id='social' first. Safe.
PUT used partial-patch via dotted keys (`links.instagram`) which preserves other platform fields — good for partial saves on blur.
SiteFooter.jsx: uses `api.get('/site/social')` (public) on mount with silent failure — footer is best-effort. Footer renders unconditionally (showing 'coming soon' message when links={}).
SocialLinksAdmin.jsx: blur-save UX is clean. The Clear button calls saveLink(key,'') after locally clearing draft — correct flow.

SocialLinksAdmin.jsx: external `Open` link href falls back to `https://${value}` if value doesn't start with `http`, which is fine but server already prefixes on save — so the fallback only matters mid-edit.
Live preview at bottom of admin page mirrors footer rendering — confirmed icons appear/disappear in sync.
Legal pages (About/Contact/Terms/Privacy) all render clean content with prose styling and back-link to /. Good.
App.js — routes for /about /contact /terms /privacy are public (no Protected wrapper). Footer rendered below <Routes> so appears on every page including /signin and /marketplace (confirmed).

rca of the issue: RCA: SocialLinksAdmin.jsx renders the 14 platform rows by mapping over `doc.platforms_supported`. The PUT handler returned `_get_doc(db) | {ok:True}` which yields {links, tagline, updated_at, ok} — missing `platforms_supported`. After any blur-save, setDoc(data) overwrote the platforms_supported with undefined and the row list collapsed to zero, blocking subsequent Clear/Open interactions. Fix: PUT now constructs the same payload as GET admin including `platforms_supported: list(DEFAULT_PLATFORMS)`. Verified via curl + E2E rerun: 'rows still=14' after save.
